messages:
lisa-docs: Heads-up — noticed the quickstart README has a copy/paste error that trips folks when they paste into a Node app. The snippet shows a sync call but the SDK is async, so newcomers get an unresolved Promise and post it to the issue tracker.

lisa-docs: Example from README:
```js
// quickstart from README
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const response = client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(response.text) // oops this is a Promise
```

sam-engineer: yep saw that in the support queue earlier today. Also the env var name in the snippet is REDWOOD_KEY but our SDK docs & examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY elsewhere — double whammy.

anya-devex: thanks for catching, lisa. I'll patch the README to use `await` and standardize the env var. Proposed fix:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const response = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
console.log(response.output)
```
Small note: using `response.output` matches the JSON schema we document in the API reference.

omar-sdk: nit: please add both JS and Python short snippets, and a short note about Node versions for top-level await. Also double-check the example uses streaming vs non-streaming shapes — new users copy the code and then wonder why partial responses are missing.

anya-devex: good call. I'll add a Python example and a one-liner: "If using Node <16.8, wrap in async fn or use .then()". I'll open a PR in docs repo in a few mins.

anya-devex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/847 — updates the quickstart, fixes env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, and updates the sample response field name.

deploy-bot: docs deploy queued by anya-devex. Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/847 (expires in 1 day) :white_check_mark:

lisa-docs: verified preview, looks clean. Thanks for the swift fix. I also added a one-liner in the README cautioning against copying API keys into public gists.

sam-engineer: can we add a tiny integration test in the examples CI to run the snippets? Just a smoke check to catch copy/paste drift.

anya-devex: yep adding a tiny CI job to run the JS snippet with a mock client. Will follow up in the PR.

lisa-docs: awesome — closing this thread after PR merges. :tada:
